messages:
Sam: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing we migrate stateful throttle to event-sourced replay instead of in-memory snapshots. Goal: deterministic replay for post-facto audits and easier backfills.
Anya: how big would the replay window be? worried about memory and catch-up spikes.
Kevin: agree w/ Anya. also we need strong dedupe keys. request_id + tenant_id should be enough? we need to define idempotency TTL.
Jordana: telemetry gap: we currently lose per-lease latency traces during replays. need plan to keep SLOs measurable.
ci-bot: CI: integration-tests/stateful-throttle ▶︎ failing — https://ci.redwood.internal/1234
Sam: thanks — rough plan:
1) implement append-only event store + compact snapshotting
2) shim layer that replays for new clients only (feature flag)
3) backfill tool that can run at low priority with rate-limit
4) long tail mitigation: resumable checkpoints + token-bucket pacing
Anya: feature flag timeline? canary on Dedicated first?
Kevin: yes canary Dedicated -> Hosted. Dedup snippet:
```
key = f"dedupe:{tenant_id}:{request_id}"
setnx(key, timestamp)
expire(key, dedupe_ttl)
```
Jordana: I'll own dashboards: per-tenant replay-rate, replay-latency, reapply-failures. need event contract for telemetry.
Sam: migration ops checklist (draft): run dry-run replays on staging, smoke tests, feature-flagged canary, monitor replay-metrics for 48h, then ramp.
Anya: also add quota-safety: replays shouldn't charge tenants twice — need idempotent token accounting.
Kevin: agreed. suggest an admission shim that rejects replayed tokens if they're already consumed in accounting ledger.
Jordana: +1. I'll add tests to the replay harness.
Sam: great—I'll open a PR with implementation sketch and ops checklist. thumbs if you approve :thumbsup:
Anya: :thumbsup:
Kevin: :thumbsup:
